_readme: Machine-readable storyboards; human version + scripts in docs/storyboards.md. status 'approved' = the daily bot generates these shots for that story (daily_post.py, REEL_STORYBOARDS). 'kling' = seeded 9:16 Soul still -> Kling 2.5 image-to-video (people). 'wan' = Wan 3.0 text-to-video (places, objects, hands). 'who' pulls a fixed cast look + seed. 'frame' is shared verbatim by both halves of a match cut so the composition lines up. 'quote': true marks the shot under the silent read beat.

earthenware.tone: deadpan comedy - locked-off camera, no camera moves, the joke is in the cut and the stillness. Never mocks the viewer; the joke is on the size of the problem.

script.hook: Most of what's eating you tonight costs under fifty bucks.
script.story: Epictetus heard a noise at the door one night, ran down, and his iron lamp was gone. He didn't rage. He worked out exactly what had happened.
script.lesson: Fair enough. And the thief paid for that lamp by becoming a thief. His plan for tomorrow: buy an earthenware one. That's the whole philosophy. Pick one thing you're still angry about that cost under fifty bucks. Say earthenware, and drop it.
